headline: Meeting cancelled; no agenda items will be taken up.
summary: The meeting has been cancelled. Residents with questions can call the Planning Department at 589-3090.
plain_text:
City of Nashua 
Planning Department 
229 Main Street 
Nashua, New Hampshire 03061-2019 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
CANCELLATION 
NOTICE 
 
 
 
The Regular Meeting of the Nashua City Planning Board for November 5, 
2026 has been cancelled. 
 
The next regular meeting of the Nashua City Planning Board will be held on 
Thursday, November 19, 2026 at 7:00 PM. in the City Hall Auditorium, 3rd 
floor, 229 Main Street. 
 
If you have any questions, contact the Planning Department at 589-3090.
